entities.title: An argument of the wrong type ends the session
entities.summary: CallTool turns only ToolException into a tool error; any other exception from a tool escapes Handle and ends the MCP session.
entities.expected: A tool call with an argument of the wrong JSON type (for example "limit": "10" or "what": 5), a malformed changed_since cursor, or an I/O error while reading a file is answered with an isError result and logged, and the session goes on.
entities.observed: Args.Str, Args.Int and Args.Bool call GetValue, which throws InvalidOperationException for a value of another JSON type; ChangedSinceTool parses cursor generations with long.Parse. These exceptions pass through McpServer.CallTool and Handle: in process they end serve; in the daemon, DaemonServer.Serve does not catch them either, so the connection closes and the client's server goes away.
reproduction: Construct McpServer with no roots and UsageLog(null).
InvalidOperationException escapes Handle instead of a result with isError true.
acceptanceCriteria: A tools/call whose arguments have the wrong types returns isError true with a bad_args-style message and writes a usage-log record with an error code, and a test covers it.

origin.description: Found while documenting the folder: read in McpServer.CallTool and Args, and reproduced with the steps above against the built library (not through the tool).
